# Jeremiah 48 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 48:1 (overlap: 21%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Concerning Moab. Thus says YHWH-of hosts, God-of Israel: "Woe to-Nebo, for it-is-destroyed! Kiriathaim is-put-to-shame, captured; the-stronghold is-put-to-shame and-dismayed." |
| LOGOS | Concerning Moab. Thus says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: "Woe to Nebo, for it is laid waste! Kiriathaim is put to shame, it is taken; the fortress is put to shame and broken down." |
| PNEUMA | This message is about Moab. The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: "How terrible for the city of Nebo — it is ruined! Kiriathaim has fallen, captured and disgraced. The stronghold is shattered and humiliated." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
